---
title: "Errors"
description: "Handle capture errors and help customers complete their scan."
---

Handle initialization errors by catching the `createCapture()` promise. After initialization, failures appear in `onState` with `Phase.FAILED` and `state.error`.

## Recovery actions

| Error | Meaning | Action |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `COUNTRY_MISMATCH` | The captured document’s issuer differs from the selection. | Ask the customer to correct the issuing country. |
| `DOCUMENT_TYPE_MISMATCH` | The captured document differs from the selected type. | Reopen document selection. |
| `CAMERA_PERMISSION_DENIED` | The browser has not granted camera access. | Ask the customer to enable permission, then retry. |
| `CAMERA_UNAVAILABLE` | The requested camera cannot be opened. | Ask the customer to close another camera app or choose another device. |
| `UNAUTHORIZED` | Capture credentials are no longer accepted. | Obtain fresh initialization data for the same scan and recreate the instance. |
| `ACCESS_DENIED` | The integration is not permitted to perform the operation. | Check credential scopes, venue access, and capture admission. |
| `NOT_FOUND` | The scan is missing or inaccessible. | Check the scan associated with this application on your backend. |
| `NETWORK_ERROR` | A request could not reach Bouncr. | Let automatic recovery run; offer [resume](/external/resume) if capture fails. |
| `INVALID_AUTHORIZATION` | Initialization token or configuration is invalid. | Check that both values belong to the same scan and environment. |
| `CAPTURE_FAILED` | Capture could not continue. | Offer a retry; record the scan ID and device/browser version for support. |

Other error codes identify invalid requests, responses, or evidence. Keep them for diagnostics and show a retry/support action rather than exposing the raw code to the customer.

## Correct a selection

Before the first capture is accepted, reopen country or document selection:

```typescript
capture.update({ country: correctedCountry, documentType: correctedDocumentType });
```

After a capture has been accepted, changing documents requires a new scan. Use `state.resumable` to distinguish these cases.

## Capture moved to another window

`Phase.SUPERSEDED` means another instance took over. Direct the customer there instead of repeatedly restarting this instance. See [Resume a scan](/external/resume#another-active-window).

## Scanner startup fails

The capture page requires HTTPS or localhost. Allow `https://cdn.bouncr.io` in script and connection policy, `blob:` for workers, and WebAssembly compilation. Check failed runtime or API requests in the browser network panel.

For support, include the SDK version, scan ID, browser/device version, error code, and failing step. The optional `onDiagnostics` callback provides timing data.
